pages.title: Busted!
pages.text: Hanging on to a police car pays more than any other ride in Skitchin', but if the officers spot you, you get a fine and you're out of the race. That's when Busted! plays.

pages.title: What the police say
pages.text: Skitchin's police officers have their own jokes. One officer says, "You're skitchin', and I'm scratchin'," meaning he's writing you a ticket. Another thanks you for helping him make his quota for the day.

pages.title: The "Bitchin'" ad
pages.text: EA's ads asked "Remember Road Rash?!" and called Skitchin' "Skatin', Hitchin', Bitchin'." Kids wrote angry letters about it. EA's publicist answered that "bitchin'" just means excellent, and it rhymes.
